section2_conclusion: URDF->SDF joint-origin conversion is arithmetically correct to 1e-9 m: gz sdf -p collapsed panda_hand into panda_link7 and recomputed each finger joint origin as hand_xyz + Rz(hand_yaw) @ urdf_origin. Axis, limits, effort, velocity, damping, friction, mass and inertia also match the URDF exactly. Candidates 1 and 2 are falsified as conversion errors.

section6_minimal_model.why: scripts/finger_minimal.py builds and launches the minimal world, and the controller advertises /model/minifinger/joint/slide/0/cmd_pos with no load errors. But no joint_state topic is published, so q cannot be read back and the model-level JointStatePublisher plugin is not producing /world/minifinger_world/model/minifinger/joint_state. Until that is fixed the minimal model has not answered section 6 and the branch is unknown.
section6_minimal_model.sdf_dialect_finding: This build reads SDF values as ELEMENT TEXT, not attributes: pose, mass, ixx..izz, lower/upper/effort/velocity, damping/friction, gravity, box size, parent/child. Written as attributes it warns "XML Attribute[..] not defined in SDF" and then fails the world with Error Code 34, "Empty string used when setting a required parameter". Same form gz sdf -p emits.
section6_minimal_model.plugin_placement_finding: JointPositionController at world level is refused: "should be attached to a model entity". A <plugins> wrapper inside <joint> is "not defined in SDF". The controller must be a <plugin> child of <model>, with joint_name/p_gain/... as element text.
section6_minimal_model.gui_finding: gz sim without -s tries to open a GUI, dies with no display, and advertises zero topics while still producing a clean-looking result file full of nulls.
